title: What will Eric Yuan say during Zoomtopia 2026 Keynote? Agentic
rules:
If 
 Eric Yuan says Agentic as part of Zoomtopia 2026 Keynote
, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the Zoomtopia 2026 Keynote using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the Zoomtopia 2026 Keynote will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Eric Yuan speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Presence alone during a livestream is not sufficient for the market to qualify (e.g., inaudible private conversations on camera, unofficial statements picked up on a hot mic).
Except as otherwise specified, previously aired content, archival footage, and recordings captured at times, places, or events wholly separate from the featured address.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.

blind.reasoning: The keynote took place October 20, 2026, and I couldn't find a transcript to check it. Zoom has framed its AI strategy as 'agentic AI' since 2025: AI Companion 3.0, ZoomMate as an 'agentic AI assistant,' and an 'Agentic Event Setup' product announced at this event. So Yuan very likely said the word at least once. The main risks are that the 2026 messaging moved toward 'context' and 'system of action,' and that other speakers may have covered the agent details.
blind.falsifier: A full transcript or video of the Zoomtopia 2026 keynote in which Eric Yuan's own remarks never include 'agentic', even if other speakers or slides use it.

final.reasoning: The keynote already took place, so a 0.06–0.26 market likely reflects traders who watched it and didn't hear Yuan say 'agentic', which outweighs my indirect, transcript-free evidence. I'm lowering my estimate to about 0.25. That leaves little edge against a wide, illiquid spread, so I'm passing.
